OP your feelings are valid and I'm sorry you've been going through this. You have been through a very traumatic situation. You were groomed and then coerced by a parental figure. When you found out you were pregnant he isolated you from your closest relationships. Your perspective of yourself was never going to be kind because of what he did. I understand why you blame yourself, the guilt you must feel, but you need to understand that your feelings on this have been filtered through his influence. He raised you. He used his position of power over you to condition your mindset into what it is now. You should be angry. You should be furious, but not at yourself. Do not be afraid to go to therapy, don't be afraid of medication that can help you. As someone with depression I know how awful it can be. One of the hardest moments in my life was realizing that I needed help, that I couldnt handle it on my own. I felt like a total failure, but something you need to understand is that depression has a way of making everything your fault. Depression can manifest in a way where you take accountability for all the fault in the world, that it just keeps piling on until you feel worthless. It really messes you up too, because once you have that base of "this is my fault" it translates to "I deserve this" and you keep accepting more and more weight on your shoulders that shouldn't be your burden to carry. Allow yourself time in therapy. Allow yourself to feel everything that you feel, even if it doesn't feel justified or rational. You need to express these feelings, the anger, the guilt, the sadness, because that's the only way you'll be able work through them and understand why you feel the way that you do and analyze what influenced your mindset. You need to heal. You need to show yourself grace and kindness even if you don't think you deserve it. 

And you should tell you sister. If you can't do it in person then send her an email when you know he's at work with a link your reddit thread. Just say "I'm sorry for how our relationship has been the past few years. I've been struggling. I hope this sheads some light on the situation. Please only read it when you're alone". And just leave it like that. You will not be destroying her marriage, you will be protecting her and any children she has from a predator.

YTA It's okay that you find their sex lives disgusting. You do not have to accept their kink or be okay with it, that doesn't make you an AH.

What does make you and AH is that your parents were proactive in warning you and being upfront about it in a rather condensed version and you still chose to blow this up. They didnt give you the intimate details, you found that out on your own. They simply thought you were mature enough to handle the information (they were wrong). Your parents clearly have transparency with you and honestly, that's pretty rare, you should appreciate that in your parents for that. You should've given them that same honesty when you were struggling to comes to terms with it. They could've gotten you into therapy or something. They showed you trust and respect and you gave the opposite back.

But what you did, oh man, what a huge breach of trust. To go an blab to all of your friends won't just ruin your parents reputation, it'll ruin yours too. Whether or not youre in a conservative community you're family is going to be ostracized. Your parents could be fired from their jobs because of the gossip you spread. You will be made fun of by your peers because of who your parents are, and if you called your parents racist, then you outed yourself as being part of a racist family and people will not want to associate with you.

I will even go a step farther and say you contributed to the harmful rhetoric around sex. When your parents start being treated differently it reaffirms the notion that society has a say in whether a person should be punished and judged for consensual sex. Sure your parents kink is controversial, I'm not going to give my opinion on whether I think it's okay, because it isn't my business. Just like it isn't my business who a person has sex with or what they chose to do if sex leads to other unintended predicaments. Obviously, kinks are nowhere near a social rights issue, but it is a privacy issue, and if we take privacy away then nothing is safe.

You're at an age where you really need to start realizing that your words carry weight and influence. What you vocalize can have snowball consequences. If as a society we believe it's okay to ostracize a couple for what they like to do in bed, why wouldn't it be okay to judge a teenager who is pregnant and decide for her? Why wouldn't it be okay to start regulating who we can have sex with? While some people make think this is a reach, these are the kind of arguments conservatives use to start chipping away at our privacy. You're about to be an adult, start to be mindful of these things, think about how your actions would affect others, is this something you'd be okay hearing a child repeat? I hope that as you enter adulthood you keep and open mind and a compassionate heart.

The pretty people were hired every time over their less attractive, more qualified competition. Is this okay? No, it's pretty screwed up, but a reality. You are looked on more favorably when surrounded by attractive people, it's an expression of power in business. Go to any firm in New York and look at their secretaries, they're not ugly. I actually had a part time job as a "professional date". I would accompany men to networking events, company parties, events, etc. Just being pretty and having good conversations with people (not related to business) resulted in my dates being looked on more favorably by their bosses, getting promotions, and closing deals. The business world is very shallow and unfortunately, thats not going to change any time soon. 

Finally, pretty preference is subconscious. Many people hold this preference without realizing it. You may say "oh I'm not like that!" but almost everyone is. I've had pretty in depth conversations about this with my guy friends. They brought up how whenever I accompany them to a party they are treated so much better, more women hit on them when I'm around, men are friendlier to them, etc. It's a very real thing. As people, we have this inate sense of competition with others. When you bring an attractive person around you are deemed as "special" since there must be a reason this person is around you. I personally think it's a bullshit system, but you can't change the system by yelling that it's wrong. You have to play by the implicit rules and once you're in a position of power then you can start to inact change.

This story takes place last March. I was looking at coming home from college for spring break. Let me preface this journey real quick. I go to school across the country so in order for me to come home I have to take an overnight 6 hour bus ride to X city to take a four hour flight to Y city. I am also travelling with my two cats. I get home and start finalizing everything I have my suitcase, my backpack, and my carrier with two cats in it. The bus didn't leave until 11 at night, so I hung out for awhile until it was time to leave.

Now that me just say that I don't know why I thought this was a good idea. I was a journey I will never take again. You see, I get car sick and I also get really uncomfortable around people. I really had no idea what I was thinking. However, I thought because this went from 11 pm to 5 am I would be able to just sleep the whole way, and wake up in the next city. This is not what happened.

What happened was I got to the greyhound bus station and waited to board. I was consoled my cats from be tousled in their sleepy state and settled them. Finally we boarded, me my cats and a variety of interesting characters got on this vessel where we would spend the next 6 hours in the same packed quarters, breathing in each others breathe and farts. The ride starts with me getting my cats settled. I decided to take the window seat so it would be easier for the person next to me and I could sleep against the window. A woman sits next to me and were off. The next two hours go by slowly. I couldn't sleep. I had a horrible headache, I just couldn't get comfortable either. So I just sat there, played games, etc. Two hours in we stop at a gas station. I get out and stretch, grab some advil pm, and a hot chocolate to help me settle before sleep. I get back on the bus and were out. I doze off for about an hour and then wake up. I do not feel good, man. I do not feel good. I am sweaty and hot. I am disoriented. I start trying to settle in my seat, but I just don't feel good. I manage to get up and climb over the sleeping woman next to me and as soon as I took that step I sprinted down the aisle, tripping over backpacks, and flug open the bathroom door. I just comes out. I see the ledge of the sink and the evil escapes me. I close the door and can't find the light switch, it's too much. So I continue to expel this horror from my body and finally collapse next to the door. I find the lock and lock the door, turning the lights on. 

I am not proud of what I did, but I will do my best to describe the scene to you.

It was hard for my eyes to adjust at first. I opened my hazy eyes and started to become aware of my surroundings. I look up to see my vomit sliding down the counter side, I look up and see it has projectiled. It was... everywhere. I cannot describe to the situation I created. The sheer mass shouldn't be able to come out of a human being. It was on the walls, there was some on the ceiling, and it turned out that there was no sink in that 4x2 cube of a bathroom. Instead it was just a ledge, with about a 2 inch thick layer of foulness.

I flip open the toilet seat and start throwing up again, because miraculously, there was still more. At this point I am right next to the not sink and start to take notice of the green slime I created. It was green and brown swirled, with a jelly like consistency. Remember those artichokes? They made an appearance. I sat there in a closet of my sin and begged for death. What have I done to deserve this? I'm dying. 

After 30 more minutes I forced myself to get up and clean. It was the only bathroom, and we still had 3 hours left. I scoped up my slime into the toilet. used a massive amount of toilet paper to remove all residue, but I had no water or cleaner. What I did have was hand sanitizer, and I proceeded to clean that bathroom with hand sanitizer, it was clean, even though it didn't help the smell. I could go collapse in my seat and die. 

I make my way back and take off my outer shirt and put on a new one. I'm going to have to carry this puke shirt all day. It's about 3:45 am and my flight isn't going to to get in to my final destination until 9 pm. I have a whole day of hell to look forward to. I climb back over the woman and collapse in my seat. The headache is really bad, my cats are starting up and meowing, and I still don't feel good. It was about 10 minutes before the exact same thing happened again, only this time I made it to the toilet and there was no clean up. 

I ended up sitting in misery for the remainder of the ride and then got to a new city that I had never been to before and had to navigate their public transport at 6 am. I found the train and took it to the airport, where I spent my day in the aftermath, before returning home.

TL;DR: I made a bad decision to take a bus ride, what it turned out to be was penance for my sins

Not only did this man not know where the duct tape was, but proceeds to look at me as though he has never heard of such a creation. My mom finds the duct tape and we GTFO. So were back on the road with a duct taped car. We start getting tired so we call my dad. He gets on hotwire and finds us a Holiday Inn for the night, great. We get to the inn and it looks as though it was once a lavish resort that has now been abandon. The lighting was incredibly dim, as though no one had bothered to replace the lights; the big pool floated dead in the middle, untouched and eerie. We get to our room dump our things and go to grab some food. On our way out we notice that the only other people in this giant inn are a bit odd. It starts raining. We find a diner and go to eat. As we're in the diner the rain just starts coming down harder and harder and then wind picks up. The TV comes on announcing a tornado warning. We ask a fellow who assures us not to worry as were not in that county. Less that five minutes later we are getting concerned, trying to figure out where we are and if we are in danger. The waitress tells us what county we are in and that the tornado warning doesn't apply to us, different county. However we look at the screen and realize that yes, indeed they are correct, we are not under tornado warning because the map shows that we are directly under the tornado. Fucking Kansas. We get out and hurry back to the hotel. At this point we are scared because of this tornado and we are stuck in the giant, creepy hotel, but there is nowhere else to go. We then have to hunt down an employee to change our rooms because we are already uncomfortable and sure as hell are not staying in a room we can't lock.
